powersOfTen = [0] * 18
powersOfTen[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 18):
    powersOfTen[i] = powersOfTen[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def findMinimumCost(value, position):
    count = value // powersOfTen[position]
    if value % powersOfTen[position] == 0:
        return position * count
    costOption1 = position * count + findMinimumCost(value % powersOfTen[position], position - 1)
    costOption2 = position * (count + 1) + findMinimumCost(powersOfTen[position] - (value % powersOfTen[position]), position - 1)
    return min(costOption1, costOption2)

num = int(input())
print(findMinimumCost(num, 17))
